data.title: Navigating the Four Quadrants: Advanced Coordinate Challenge
data.description: Practice coordinate plane skills with Ordered pairs on the coordinate plane

challenges.instruction: Plot the point (-4, 7) on the coordinate plane to mark the location of a stationary drone.
challenges.hint: Begin at the origin, move 4 units horizontally to the left along the x-axis, and then travel 7 units vertically upward.

challenges.instruction: Plot the point (5, -8) on the coordinate plane to identify a submerged treasure.
challenges.hint: This point resides in Quadrant IV, where x-coordinates are positive and y-coordinates are negative.

challenges.instruction: Plot the point (-6, -3) on the coordinate plane to locate an archaeological artifact.
challenges.hint: Since both coordinates are negative, your final destination lies in the third quadrant.

challenges.instruction: Plot the point (8, 2) on the coordinate plane representing a satellite's tracking coordinate.
challenges.hint: Focus on the y-axis: from the origin, move 8 units right and then elevate 2 units straight up.

challenges.instruction: Plot the point (-9, -5) on the coordinate plane to plot a seismic anomaly.
challenges.hint: Count 9 units left along the horizontal axis before descending 5 units parallel to the vertical axis.
